verified_facts.text: The resort is on Maamunagau Island in Raa Atoll, Republic of Maldives.
verified_facts.excerpt: MAAMUNAGAU ISLAND RAA ATOLL, REPUBLIC OF MALDIVES

verified_facts.text: Guests arrive by seaplane to the shores of Raa Atoll.
verified_facts.excerpt: be mesmerised by island life from the moment you board the seaplane to the tranquil shores of the Raa Atoll

verified_facts.text: The resort sits close to the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, with a manta ray sanctuary adjacent to the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled close to the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, prepare to be amazed by the myriad of marine life in our lagoon including a unique manta ray sanctuary adjacent to this luxury resort in Maldives.

verified_facts.text: Reef manta rays feed in Maamunagau Lagoon during the Northeast Monsoon months, December to April, and the lagoon is a nursery ground for juvenile mantas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Witness the majestic reef manta rays during Northeast Monsoonal months (Dec-April), as they feed in Maamunagau Lagoon. This lagoon also serves as a vital nursery ground for juvenile mantas.

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore the marine life of Raa Atoll with the Manta Trust.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore the marine life in and around Raa Atoll with the Manta Trust

verified_facts.text: Sea turtles nest on Maamunagau Island, and the resort protects their nests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Maamunagau Island is a haven for sea turtles. We protect their nests and witness the incredible journey of hatchlings to the ocean.

verified_facts.text: The house reef is steps from the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore our vibrant house reef just steps from the beach, teeming with diverse coral species.

verified_facts.text: A guided snorkelling trip near Maamunagau Island goes to see nurse sharks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a guided snorkelling experience just moments from Maamunagau Island, where nurse sharks are often seen gliding through calm, crystal-clear waters.

verified_facts.text: A large lagoon surrounds the entire island, with snorkelling spots home to black tip reef sharks, dolphins and turtles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our island is blessed with a large lagoon which surrounds the entire island and is home to several snorkelling spots, thriving with diverse fish, black tip reef sharks, dolphins and turtles.

verified_facts.text: Dolphin cruises go out on a dhoni.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set sail on a dhoni cruise in search of playful dolphins.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a private luxury yacht trip with chef-curated bites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Escape beyond the shoreline on your own luxury yacht, where time slows and the horizon feels endless. With personalised service, fine pours, and chef-curated bites

verified_facts.text: Sandbank experiences take guests to a sandbank surrounded by the Indian Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: escape to a sandbank surrounded by the crystal clear Indian Ocean

verified_facts.text: AVI Spa is an overwater spa with six overwater treatment villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: An overwhelming feeling of calm permeates throughout the six overwater treatment villas

verified_facts.text: AVI means sunshine in the local language.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meaning “sunshine” in the language of our island home

verified_facts.text: AVI Spa treatments use brands such as The Organic Pharmacy, VitaJuwel Crystal Gemstones, Biologique Recherche and Margaret Dabbs products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover unique therapies or indulge in signature treatments using leading wellness brands such as The Organic Pharmacy, VitaJuwel Crystal Gemstones,  Biologique Recherche and Margret Dabb’s Pure Products.

verified_facts.text: AVI Spa was named Luxury Island Resort Spa at the World Luxury Spa Awards 2020.
verified_facts.excerpt: AVI Spa has recently been adjudged “Luxury Island Resort Spa” at the World Luxury Spa Awards 2020

verified_facts.text: The resort runs a visiting wellness practitioner programme.
verified_facts.excerpt: The wellness visiting practitioners programme at InterContinental Maldives Maamunagau Resort aims to provide our guests with an opportunity to discover new ways of wellness

verified_facts.excerpt: Drift into a quieter state with Floating Sound Therapy, a water-based session designed to release tension and settle the senses.
